passages.en: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:

passages.en: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder and perish, for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”
passages.ko: 일렀으되 보라 멸시하는 사람들아 너희는 놀라고 망하라 내가 너희 때를 당하여 한 일을 행할 것이니 사람이 너희에게 이를찌라도 도무지 믿지 못할 일이라 하였느니라 하니라

passages.en: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.

passages.en: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.
passages.ko: 폐회한 후에 유대인과 유대교에 입교한 경건한 사람들이 많이 바울과 바나바를 좇으니 두 사도가 더불어 말하고 항상 하나님의 은혜 가운데 있으라 권하니라

passages.en: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

passages.en: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.

passages.en: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.
passages.ko: 바울과 바나바가 담대히 말하여 가로되 하나님의 말씀을 마땅히 먼저 너희에게 전할 것이로되 너희가 버리고 영생 얻음에 합당치 않은 자로 자처하기로 우리가 이방인에게로 향하노라

passages.en: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”

passages.en: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.

passages.en: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.
